description: CityScroll warehouse dataset registry. WH-01 scaffold + WH-02 bulk pack + WH-04 ER batch inputs + WH-05 serve lookups + WH-07 City Record snapshot + tax-lien prediction inputs + RC-4 ABO residual measurement.

wh02_pack.first_pick_rationale: Named on the WH-02 card, already WH-01 fixture-proven, ~53k rows — real bulk volume without City Record's ~1.1M row surface. Money-spine value high.
wh02_pack.deferred_notes: Add next only when headroom stays green after the previous pack. City Record last (largest).

ocp-recent-contract-awards.name: Recent Contract Awards (OCP)
ocp-recent-contract-awards.notes: WH-02 first bulk pick. Full rows.csv under --bulk --ack-large.

city-record.name: City Record Online
city-record.notes: Largest Socrata surface (~1.1M rows). WH-02 queue last; prefer Mini overnight.

abo-local-authorities.name: NYS ABO Procurement Report for Local Authorities
abo-local-authorities.notes: RC-4 source. The guarded residual runner pulls only registry authorities and materializes abo_procurement_award; generic ingest remains bounded.

abo-local-development-corporations.name: NYS ABO Procurement Report for Local Development Corporations
abo-local-development-corporations.notes: RC-4 source. The guarded residual runner pulls only registry authorities and materializes abo_procurement_award; generic ingest remains bounded.

abo-state-authorities.name: NYS ABO Procurement Report for State Authorities
abo-state-authorities.notes: RC-4 source. transaction_number is preserved as the only explicit source identifier; no sampled state-authority notice counterpart existed.

dof-tax-lien-sale-lists.name: DOF Tax Lien Sale Lists
dof-tax-lien-sale-lists.soda_order: month ASC, cycle ASC, borough ASC, block ASC, lot ASC

bulk_paging.order: month ASC, cycle ASC, borough ASC, block ASC, lot ASC

dof-tax-lien-sale-lists.notes: Per-BBL 90/60/30/10-day and final-sale publications used by the transparent tax-lien progression model. Raw bulk and parquet stay uncommitted.

zap-projects.name: ZAP Project Data
zap-projects.notes: WH-05 second bulk pack + fetchOpenDataRow materialization. The bulk receipt profiles milestone/status-date coverage for zoning duration statistics. ~33k rows.

zap-bbl.name: ZAP BBL
zap-bbl.notes: WH-06 third bulk pack + fetchBbls materialization. ~132k rows; project_id ↔ BBL.

doing-business-entities.name: Doing Business Search Entities
doing-business-entities.notes: ER batch (WH-04) target. Small (~11k); optional pack after primary queue.

nycedc-project-documents.name: NYCEDC annual project and authority board documents
nycedc-project-documents.notes: Host-side, checkpointed document collector. Publisher index pages get one polite attempt; direct official documents remain hash-addressed and unmatched notice rows remain unmatched.
